subject: Turning drawings into manufactured components
hook: Trade component production from our Hanley workshop
gbp:
Trade component production from our Hanley workshop, Stoke-on-Trent.

If you are a joiner, kitchen fitter, shopfitter or small furniture maker, we can turn your drawings or cutting list into ready-to-build components. Send us your specification and we will process it through our own machines:

- Panel cutting on a sliding table panel saw, to your finished sizes
- ABS edge banding in 0.4, 1 or 2 mm
- Panel drilling on a multi-spindle boring machine: hinge cups, shelf-pin rows, dowels
- Cabinet assembly if you would rather receive carcasses than flat panels

Every part is labelled to match your list, so sorting and assembly on site is straightforward. Collection from the workshop is by arrangement, and delivery is quoted per job.

It is a practical option when board processing is taking time away from fitting, or when you need consistent components across a run of cabinets.

Trade and domestic orders welcome. Send your cutting list for a priced quote.
